총 32개 toolgroup이 조회되었습니다. 주요 속성 예시는 아래와 같습니다:

- toolgroup: DE_BE_11, number_of_tools: 10, location: Fab, dispatching: SuperHotLotFIRST_and_Reservation, ranking: Highest Lotpriority / Least Setuptime / FIFO
- toolgroup: DE_BE_11_SIM_029, number_of_tools: 13
- toolgroup: DE_BE_12, number_of_tools: 9
- toolgroup: DE_BE_13, number_of_tools: 21, tool_wake_up_ranking: wake up Least Setuptime
- toolgroup: DE_BE_48, number_of_tools: 10
- toolgroup: DE_BE_50, number_of_tools: 9
- toolgroup: DE_BE_65, number_of_tools: 17
- toolgroup: DE_BE_66, number_of_tools: 19, tool_wake_up_ranking: wake up Least Setuptime
- toolgroup: DE_FE_1, number_of_tools: 7 등

모든 toolgroup은 'Fab' 내에 위치하며, 대부분의 dispatching 정책은 "SuperHotLotFIRST_and_Reservation"이고, ranking은 "Highest Lotpriority", "Least Setuptime", "FIFO" 순서로 설정되어 있습니다.
